pool.text: Blakeney made the first discovery of gold in the Yellowknife Bay area.
Two prospectors surveyed for possible mineral deposits along the Yellowknife River.
Baker returned to develop gold finds and search for more near Yellowknife.
The Wildcat Cafe opened in Yellowknife.
Con Mine entered production in the region.
Yellowknife officially became the capital of the Northwest Territories.
Yellowknife hosted the inaugural Arctic Winter Games.
A Soviet nuclear-powered satellite crashed to Earth near Yellowknife.
Folk on the Rocks has been held annually in Yellowknife.
Diamonds were discovered north of Yellowknife, sparking a new mining rush.
The Giant Mine was the subject of a bombing during a labour dispute.
The Ekati Diamond Mine opened near Yellowknife.
The Diavik Diamond Mine began production near Yellowknife.
The last of Yellowknife's gold mines closed.
The Old Town Ramble & Ride Festival started in Yellowknife.
The Snap Lake Diamond Mine went into production.
Ice Wireless entered the market in Yellowknife.
Yellowknife had its first direct road connection to the rest of the country.
NASA announced that a section of Mars would be renamed Yellowknife.
The Gahcho Kue Diamond Mine officially opened near Yellowknife.
